lesson.subtitle: Lesson 3 -- My Morning
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 3 -- My Morning
lesson.grammar_point: present simple with I and you + telling the time

listenings.text: Good morning. This is the front desk of the building. The gym opens at five in the morning and it closes at ten at night. Breakfast is from six to nine, on floor two. The coffee machine on floor twelve is free for everybody. The elevator is slow before eight, so please come early. Have a good morning.

Hi Ricardo. This is Diane. My morning is different from yours. I wake up at seven o'clock. I go to the gym after work, in the evening. I have breakfast at home with my son. I drink two coffees before nine. I start work at eight thirty. And you? You wake up very early. Tell me about your morning on Monday. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: I wake up at five in the morning. I go to the gym. I take a shower at home. I have breakfast and one coffee. I start work at nine o'clock.
